description: The file defines a LocationService class that manages location updates and authorization for iOS using CoreLocation. It includes methods for requesting location data, handling authorization changes, starting/stopping location updates, and monitoring significant location changes.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous location updates, handling permissions, and significant location change monitoring on iOS.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Requests and ensures the appropriate location authorization mode is granted.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters and timeout.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Begins streaming location updates with specified accuracy and change monitoring options.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and feeds.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Starts monitoring for significant location changes with a callback.
